via.name: minimatch
via.title: minimatch has potential denial of service via globparts amplification

npm.disposition: PENDING explicit acceptance for evidence generation; not an application deployment waiver
npm.proposed_scope: Two moderate CDK tooling findings only. API audit clean. No high/critical acceptance; producer image scans remain mandatory. No dependency changes or downgraded CDK.

dispositions.risk: Attacker-controlled glob patterns can cause excessive CPU and memory consumption during minimatch preprocessing (optimizationLevel >= 2).
dispositions.remediation_status: Unfixed in current CDK lockfile; upstream minimatch 11.0.1 is patched. CDK bundles minimatch 10.2.6. npm proposes CDK 2.239.0 downgrade, not an approved compatible remediation. No dependency change made.
dispositions.proposed_disposition: Time-limited acceptance solely for signed artifact preparation; no application deployment or image vulnerability waiver.
dispositions.justification: Producer builds only app/demo-inference-api, app/bot-city and app/egress-proxy contexts, not infra/cdk. CDK package is outside all three contexts. Inference lockfile audit is clean. This narrows producer exposure; CI/CDK tooling exposure remains and is not declared fixed.
compensating_controls: Protected reviewed source and required CI
No AWS credential acquisition in producer
Mandatory fresh image vulnerability and secret scans

approving_authority.required: Flem15, repository owner and project risk owner

dispositions.proposed_expiry: 24 hours from explicit approval, and never beyond supporting evidence freshness
reassessment_triggers: Source changes that introduce CDK into image build contexts
New dependency audit or remediation availability
